caption: The drawing depicts a rooster figure mounted on top of a rectangular box. The rooster is colored in shades of brown, beige, white, blue, green, red, black, and yellow. Its body and wings are a mix of beige, white, brown, and blue, with the tail feathers prominently colored in blue, green, and a touch of pink and yellow. The rooster's comb and wattle are red, and its beak is yellow. The figure stands upright, attached to the box by a coiled spring that serves as its legs. The box is colored in varying shades of reddish-brown and orange, with a green top surface. The left side of the box features a cord extending out, ending in a triangular, dark-colored (possibly black) handle or weight. The box rests on a flat surface, and there is a faint signature "JOHN FISK" at the bottom right of the drawing. The objects are centered within a rectangular border on an off-white background.
title: Pa. German Bellows Toy Rooster
